FACILITIES AND RESEARCH
The department is facilitated with a well-equipped laboratory. Lending Library of the campus proves to be a good source of knowledge and reference material for students as well as the faculty members of the department. The department offers research courses and research thesis at MSc. & MS level. The department faculty publishes research articles in national and international Journals and is efficient in presenting papers in seminars and symposia
